description: The domains of one site whose settings CodeGene looks after, and for each every address that forwards email (such as info@acme.com) to an inbox the person already reads, with how each stands in plain words: forwarding, being set up, waiting for someone to confirm Cloudflare's email, or a confirmation link that ran out. Includes why a domain is paused and the settings page where the person sees it all. CodeGene forwards only: it gives no mailbox.

workspace_id.description: Workspace id from whoami; omit when there is one.

name: list_email_forwarding
title: Email forwarding at a site's domains
